calibration.purpose: binary-search smallest fixed calls/iterations measured at or above target before each SERIES N=31; excluded from statistics and evidence

P_instr.cores: all 8 physical P and all 8 physical E cores individually, one pinned worker at a time
P_instr.outer_loop_iterations_per_sample: fixed by ENGINEERING_CALIBRATION_ONLY independently per worker and route

P_instr.implementation: MASM register-only loops in phase1_instr_x64.asm; QPC wall bracket, RDTSCP records loop-cycle diagnostics; eight distinct vector accumulator initial values prevent CSE; raw accumulator vectors are stored as a sink after the RDTSCP window, without an external horizontal reduction
P_instr.operands: signed-word operands in YMM registers before QPC/RDTSCP; no Q4 decode, scale conversion, weight loads, or external reduction in timed loop

P_Q4_m.calls_per_sample: fixed by ENGINEERING_CALIBRATION_ONLY independently per worker, route, and M
P_Q4_m.m_tile_policy: frozen engineering choice: M=1 uses tile 1; M=2 uses tile 2; M in {4,8,16,32} uses tile 4 (four independent FP32 row accumulators; decode one weight group once and reuse across four activation rows)
P_Q4_m.kernel_weight_payload_traversals_per_cal: M/m_tile (exact; all official M divide their tile)
P_Q4_m.kernel_weight_payload_load_bytes_logical: canonical_weight_payload_bytes_per_call * kernel_weight_payload_traversals_per_call; logical traversal accounting, not physical bytes actually read
P_Q4_m.scale_conversion: F16C VCVTPH2PS; one scale conversion per weight group per output; reuse its converted value across the 4-row activation block; no persistent repack/scale sidecar
P_Q4_m.core_workers: P_ref only: physical P-core with lowest stable physical_core_api_key; current frozen key CORE_API_00_G0_MASK_0_1
P_Q4_m.route_order: alternates by M index: AVX2 then VNNI for even indices, VNNI then AVX2 for odd indices
P_Q4_m.working_set: packed weights reused; prewarmed with 5 repetitions of the frozen calibrated call count; Q4 activation/warm buffers and output allocated/validated before timed region
